name: @alexgorbatchev/shadcn

scripts.test: vitest run --config .storybook/vitest.config.ts && bun run test:native && bun run test:package
scripts.test:package: bun run build && bun test scripts/__tests__ ./.storybook/__tests__/createStorybookViteConfig.test.ts
